_about: Points read from the 2022 CAD sheet (display points) that build-plan.mjs maps to the render grid with transform.json: the ENTRY arrows into the five courts, the security cabins beside them (7'2" x 9'0") and the row-house entry where the 30 ft spine passes from the flats into the row houses. Court sectors follow the SECTOR label whose court the entry opens into.
